headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: NOR (5)

summary: Oscar Piastri won the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 2.8s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Lando Norris made the biggest climb, from P10 to P4.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised VER (5 second time penalty) and LAW (10 second time penalty).
There were 19 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Oscar Piastri takes the championship lead, 10 points ahead of Lando Norris.
